name: coordinator-marketplace
description: Multi-agent project coordination for Claude Code: core principles plus a per-project profile (owner, coordinator, unit agents; optional Platform, QA, Reviewer).

plugins.name: coordinator
plugins.description: Run a software project with several Claude sessions in any shape (one repo with lanes, several repos, one small repo): core principles + a per-project profile, a standard ledger, task issues, review and release commands, a ledger lint, and guards that keep the coordinator out of product code and agents off merged branches.
